repository_intelligence.purpose: Instruction and template kit for scoping, launching, evaluating and handing off agents on an external managed-agent platform; not a hosted agent-runtime implementation.
repository_intelligence.reuse_recommendation: Use the skills with an authorized agent host; adapt the templates and verify current provider contracts before live deployment.
repository_intelligence.inspection_scope: Complete 16-file tree: two independently invocable skills, a reusable overview page, build-sheet structure, visibly mocked connector contracts and a version-scoped platform reference. Duplicate UI examples and interview/example banks support these assets rather than implementing a hosted agent runtime. Repository-level completion only; detailed entities are preserved unchanged.
runtime: Claude Code or adapted agent host
risk_notes: This tree contains instructions and templates, not a hosted runtime. The launch skill calls for owner credentials in local environment/vault storage rather than chat, exposes permission/network decisions and stages write connectors behind explicit configuration. Outbox mocks are not delivered messages; custom-tool mocks block pending a host response and are unsuitable for unattended scheduling. Live launch, spend, network policy and schedule mutations require operator authority in the executing environment. No credentials were supplied, no provider call was made and no deployment or inspected script was run during this census.
